configurePresets.name: base
configurePresets.description: Configure from an MSYS2 UCRT64 shell (cmake/ninja/clang live there).

configurePresets.name: base-x86
configurePresets.description: Everything the 32-bit presets share. Run them from an MSYS2 MINGW32 shell: no toolchain paths are pinned, so CMake picks up both the compiler and the 32-bit GTest from PATH. AFW_TARGET_POINTER_SIZE makes a wrong shell a configure error instead of a silent 64-bit build. The lint gate stays off because clang-format and clang-tidy do not depend on the target architecture, and the 64-bit presets already run them.

configurePresets.name: dev-debug
configurePresets.description: Primary UCRT64 development build. GCC has no sanitizer runtime, so SANITIZER_MODE stays None.

configurePresets.name: dev-debug-asan
configurePresets.description: ASan+UBSan. On Windows only Clang ships the ASan runtime, so this preset forces clang++.

configurePresets.name: dev-debug-ubsan
configurePresets.description: UBSan only. Reliable under Clang on Windows; forces clang++.

configurePresets.name: ci-coverage
configurePresets.description: gcov instrumentation (GCC). Debug so branches/inlining stay observable. Static analysis off for speed.

configurePresets.name: ci-release
configurePresets.description: Final aimbot.dll build. Tests off, no sanitizers.

configurePresets.name: dev-debug-x86
configurePresets.description: The 32-bit development build. Far Cry 3 is a 32-bit process, so the injector and the DLL that ship have to come from a 32-bit preset.

configurePresets.name: ci-relwithdebinfo-x86
configurePresets.description: Optimised and still carrying symbols. The one to reach for when the game crashes and the stack has to be readable.

configurePresets.name: ci-release-x86
configurePresets.description: The pair that ships into the game. Tests off. This is also the smallest image: a 32-bit process has little address space left once the engine and the display driver are mapped, and the loader needs the DLL's SizeOfImage as one free run.
